correctness.rationale: Using F_n(X)=Π_{j=0}^{n-1}(X+j) and P_n=F_n', the identity h_n^(r)=P_n(r)/n! is exact, so integrality is a polynomial-congruence problem. For each p|45!, the difference P_45(X+m_p)-P_45(X) has degree <=43; its divisibility by p^e at X=0..43 implies divisibility at all integers using Newton forward differences in the integer-valued binomial basis. Independently computed all 14 prime-power local periods, all 616 certificates and every one of 1,817 residues; counts [32,18,20,25,41,92,193,145,22,16,14,8,4,2] exactly reproduce the CRT period M=1096405020816651129231648000 and numerator 9588267818680320000, reduced density 15810560/1807915433082759. Checked explicit CRT witness mod 45!. For n=35 independently proved 49-shift mod 7^5 from 34 values and checked all 49 residues nonroot; published even/prime-power and 2<=n<=32 obstructions plus known positive n=33,39 establish third admissible index. Finite enumeration becomes all-integer only through the proved shift lemma; the n-ordering also relies on external nonintegrality theorem.
